_README: Startup credit programs for /guides/startup-credits/: a dated copy of the Colorado Startups Compute repo's public export. site/src/lib/guides/credits.ts parses it with zod, and a bad file fails the build.
'export' is the export file verbatim. Never edit it by hand: fix the source in the Compute repo (free-compute/startup-programs.json, built by free-compute/build_public.py) and copy again.

Refresh: replace 'export' with the contents of the Compute repo's free-compute/public/startup-programs.public.json, set 'from.commit' to the Compute commit it came from, then run the site tests. A test fails when an 'omit' id is gone or a new provider has not been checked against the China rule.
'omit' lists rows the guide leaves out, each with its reason. The page shows every other row.

omit.why: a GPU vendor's program, which the guide leaves out (decision 80)
a GPU vendor's program, which the guide leaves out (decision 80)
a GPU vendor's program, which the guide leaves out (decision 80)
a GPU vendor's program, which the guide leaves out (decision 80)
open only to teams in Europe or Asia, per fal's page; this guide is for founders in Colorado

export.about: Startup credit programs for founders, public fields only. Built by free-compute/build_public.py from free-compute/startup-programs.json; edit that file, never this one. Programs change: each row carries the first-party page it was read on and the date.

rows.amount_note: New accounts get $100 in credits at sign-up. Completing activities in the console earns up to $100 more. New customers who pick the Paid plan get the same credits.
requirements: New AWS customer who has never had an AWS account
Free Tier credits for one account per person
Complete the Explore AWS activities within 6 months to earn the second $100
rows.term: 6 months on the Free plan, or until the credits run out

traps.expiry: The Free plan ends 6 months after sign-up or when credits run out. After an upgrade, leftover credits apply to bills until they expire; AWS pages give both 6 and 12 months from account creation.
other: A Free plan account cannot receive other promotional credits, AWS Activate included. Upgrading to the Paid plan lifts that block.
The Free plan excludes services that would use the whole credit at once or need hardware purchases.
GPU use on the Free plan is not stated. None of the six Free tier eligible EC2 instance types is a GPU type.
When the Free plan expires, AWS suspends the account and deletes it after 90 days unless you upgrade.
AWS may ask some new customers for a payment method to verify identity.
Joining AWS Organizations or setting up Control Tower, among other actions, moves the account to the Paid plan.
